myAgents.title: My agents
myAgents.subtitle: Pause an agent to hide it from the marketplace without losing it.

pause.title: Pause “{{title}}”?
pause.text: It disappears from the marketplace, your profile, rankings and other members' favorites. Likes, views and comments stop until you activate it again.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.text: This can't be undone: the agent leaves your list for good. To hide it for a while, pause it instead.

errors.changed: This agent was changed or removed in the meantime. The list has been reloaded.

empty.title: List your first agent
empty.text: Add an agent with a clear title, honest pricing and a few screenshots. You can edit it any time.

deleteNote.text: A deleted agent disappears from your list and can't be restored. To hide it for a while, pause it instead.

preview.paused: This agent is paused. Only you can see it. Activate it to list it in the marketplace again.
preview.live: This agent is live in the marketplace.
